appDescription: An in-car errand agent that uses the navigation arrival time, location and vehicle state to handle errands outside the car: running late for reservations, ordering pickups along the route, meeting a contact halfway, replying to emails by voice (sent only after the driver reviews it when stopped), charging with a restaurant waitlist, and undoing an errand it just completed.

function.name: NOTIFY_LATE_ARRIVAL
function.description: Handle the situation where the driver is running late for an appointment or reservation by estimating the delay from the navigation arrival time and rescheduling it to a new time the user approves.

appointmentTime.description: Originally scheduled time of the appointment or reservation in 24-hour HH:mm format.

confirmedTime.description: New reservation time the user explicitly approved after being asked, in 24-hour HH:mm format.

function.name: ORDER_PICKUP_ON_ROUTE
function.description: Order food or drinks for pickup at a store along the current navigation route, timed to the driver's arrival.

item.description: Name of the food or drink the user wants to pick up.

storeName.description: Name or brand of the store the user wants to order from.

confirmed.description: Whether the user explicitly approved the proposed store and pickup time after being asked.

function.name: HANDLE_PITCREW_REQUEST
function.description: Handle any other PitCrew errand from the driver's own words: meet a contact halfway between both people's locations, reply to the latest email by voice (the reply is only drafted, and it is sent after the driver reviews it on screen when stopped), find a charging stop and join a nearby restaurant waitlist while charging, or undo the errand PitCrew completed in the last few minutes.

request.description: The driver's request sentence exactly as spoken, in the original language (Korean). Do not translate, summarize or rephrase it.

confirmed.description: Whether the user explicitly approved what PitCrew proposed after being asked.
